pins.name: D0
pins.label: D0 (GPIO0)
pins.notes: RP2350_PSRAM_CS — dedicated chip-select line to the onboard 8MB PSRAM chip. Confirmed via this board's own pins_arduino.h (`RP2350_PSRAM_CS (0u)`). Previously exposed as a full-capability D0 pin via the shared generic/common.h D-alias fallback; excluded here to match this repo's established PSRAM-CS precedent (solderparty_rp2350_stamp_xl GPIO8). Not general-purpose.

pins.name: D8
pins.label: D8 (GPIO8)
pins.notes: PIN_SERIAL2_TX — no vendor/firmware source found tying this to any fixed onboard peripheral (the XBee LR module is confirmed hardwired to Serial1/GPIO18-19 instead, per flxLoRaWANDigi.h's `#define kXBeeLRSerial Serial1`). Left as an ordinary general-purpose D8 pin — 'report NO CHANGE rather than guess' policy. Listed here only for documentation continuity; matches the chip-level default capability set.

pins.name: D9
pins.label: D9 (GPIO9)
pins.notes: PIN_SERIAL2_RX — same reasoning as GPIO8. No confirmed dedicated onboard use found; left as an ordinary general-purpose D9 pin.

pins.name: D12
pins.label: D12 (GPIO12)
pins.notes: PIN_SPI0_MISO — onboard microSD card slot's dedicated data line. This board's pins_arduino.h remaps its default/only usable SPI bus onto the physical spi1 hardware peripheral specifically for the microSD card ("the board uses SPI1 for uSD card, make that the default"); PIN_SPI1_* is entirely sentineled to 31/not pinned out, so there is no second, free SPI bus on this board. Confirmed via the official firmware's `kNLBoardSDCardCSPin = 13` (matching PIN_SPI0_SS on this same bus). Note: build_boards.js will still auto-attach "spi_miso" via the shared generic/common.h MISO static-const alias, independent of this override — accurate, since this genuinely is the board's one real SPI bus, just already fully consumed by the onboard microSD socket.

pins.name: D13
pins.label: D13 (GPIO13)
pins.notes: PIN_SPI0_SS — onboard microSD card slot's dedicated chip-select line. Directly confirmed by the official firmware's `const uint8_t kNLBoardSDCardCSPin = 13;`. Same "spi_ss" auto-attach caveat as GPIO12 above.

pins.name: D14
pins.label: D14 (GPIO14)
pins.notes: PIN_SPI0_SCK — onboard microSD card slot's dedicated clock line. Same bus/reasoning as GPIO12/13. Same "spi_sck" auto-attach caveat.

pins.name: D15
pins.label: D15 (GPIO15)
pins.notes: PIN_SPI0_MOSI — onboard microSD card slot's dedicated data line. Same bus/reasoning as GPIO12/13. Same "spi_mosi" auto-attach caveat.

pins.name: D18
pins.label: D18 (GPIO18)
pins.notes: PIN_SERIAL1_TX — dedicated UART TX to the onboard Digi XBee LR LoRaWAN module. Confirmed via the official firmware's flxLoRaWANDigi.h: `#define kXBeeLRSerial Serial1`, used directly to construct the XBeeArduino object. Not general-purpose. No SDA/SCL/SS/MOSI/MISO/SCK alias collision on this GPIO.

pins.name: D19
pins.label: D19 (GPIO19)
pins.notes: PIN_SERIAL1_RX — dedicated UART RX to the onboard Digi XBee LR LoRaWAN module. Same source/reasoning as GPIO18.

pins.name: GPIO24
pins.label: GPIO24 (Button)
pins.notes:
User Button — confirmed via the official firmware's sfeNLBoard.h (`const uint8_t kNLBoardUserButton = 24;`) and sfeNLButton.cpp (`pinMode(kNLBoardUserButton, INPUT_PULLUP); attachInterrupt(kNLBoardUserButton, userButtonISR, CHANGE);` with active-low digitalRead logic). Not aliased anywhere in this board's pins_arduino.h — added directly as a chipGpios entry. Full digital_input/digital_output/pwm_output capability retained (ordinary bidirectional GPIO wired to a momentary switch to ground), matching this repo's established button-pin precedent.
Check if available on board

pins.name: GPIO25
pins.label: GPIO25 (Led Neopixel)
pins.notes:
PIN_LED / PIN_NEOPIXEL — single onboard WS2812 NeoPixel that doubles as the board's LED_BUILTIN (pins_arduino.h: PIN_LED==PIN_NEOPIXEL==25, NUM_NEOPIXEL=1; firmware sfeNLBoard.h: kNLBoardLEDBuiltin==kNLBoardLEDRGBBuiltin==25). Not aliased in pins_arduino.h (GPIO25 is always omitted from the shared generic/common.h D-alias list) — added directly as a chipGpios entry. digital_input/pwm_output omitted per this repo's established led_neopixel precedent (single-wire bit-banged protocol, not a plain digital level or PWM duty cycle).
Check if available on board
